title: Tyler Shough: I thought my arm was moving forward on fourth quarter fumble

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tyler Shough: I thought my arm was moving forward on fourth quarter fumble
sources.description: The Saints were upset that they had a fumble recovery taken off the board in their Week 1 loss to the Lions and they weren't any happier about the application of the rules in the fourth quarter of Week 3.
